summary: This plugin adds a right-side sidebar in DeepSeek Harness for persistent follow-up conversation branching from completed answers without leaving the main chat.

classificationSuggestion.reason: Evidence shows the plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is a UI side-panel feature for DeepSeek Harness: it enables branching follow-up chats from completed answers without leaving the main conversation, with persistent restore behavior and branch controls. It relies on existing Harness session/storage APIs and therefore adds workflow/context management rather than standalone file or external service integration, though child sessions can still execute normal tools affecting the same workspace.
